definition: to put a clean nappy on a baby
exampleSentence: I change the baby's nappy every three hours.
exampleTranslation: Cứ ba tiếng tôi thay tã cho em bé một lần.

definition: to give food or milk to a baby
exampleSentence: She feeds the baby at six.
exampleTranslation: Sáu giờ cô ấy cho em bé ăn.

definition: to feed a baby with milk from the mother
exampleSentence: She breastfeeds her baby.
exampleTranslation: Cô ấy cho con bú.

definition: to pat a baby's back to let out air after feeding
translation: vỗ ợ hơi cho em bé
exampleSentence: Burp the baby after the milk.
exampleTranslation: Vỗ ợ hơi cho em bé sau khi bú sữa.

definition: to move a baby gently to help it sleep
exampleSentence: He rocks the baby to sleep.
exampleTranslation: Bố ru em bé ngủ.

definition: to lay a baby in its bed to sleep
translation: đặt em bé vào giường ngủ
exampleSentence: I put the baby to bed at eight.
exampleTranslation: Tám giờ tôi đặt em bé vào giường ngủ.

definition: to wash a baby in water
exampleSentence: We bathe the baby in the evening.
exampleTranslation: Buổi tối chúng tôi tắm cho em bé.

definition: to move a baby's small bed on wheels along
exampleSentence: She pushes a pram in the park.
exampleTranslation: Cô ấy đẩy xe nôi trong công viên.

definition: to hold a baby in your arms
exampleSentence: He carries the baby in his arms.
exampleTranslation: Bố bế em bé trên tay.

definition: to go to school on foot with a child
translation: đưa trẻ đi bộ đến trường
exampleSentence: I walk my daughter to school.
exampleTranslation: Tôi đưa con gái đi bộ đến trường.

word: drop the kids off at school
definition: to take the children to school and leave them there
exampleSentence: I drop the kids off at school at eight.
exampleTranslation: Tám giờ tôi đưa các con đến trường.

word: pick the kids up from school
definition: to collect the children when school ends
exampleSentence: My husband picks the kids up from school.
exampleTranslation: Chồng tôi đón các con tan học.

definition: to help a child do their school work
translation: giúp làm bài tập về nhà
exampleSentence: I help my son with homework every night.
exampleTranslation: Tối nào tôi cũng giúp con trai làm bài tập về nhà.

definition: to read a story to a child before sleep
translation: đọc truyện trước giờ đi ngủ
exampleSentence: She reads a bedtime story to her son.
exampleTranslation: Cô ấy đọc truyện trước giờ đi ngủ cho con trai.

definition: to sing a soft song to help a baby sleep
exampleSentence: Mum sang a lullaby to the baby.
exampleTranslation: Mẹ hát ru em bé.

definition: to pull the blanket round a child in bed
exampleSentence: I tuck my daughter in every night.
exampleTranslation: Đêm nào tôi cũng đắp chăn cho con gái.

definition: to join in games with children
exampleSentence: He plays with the kids after work.
exampleTranslation: Sau giờ làm bố chơi với các con.

definition: to play a game where one person looks for others who are hiding
exampleSentence: The children play hide and seek in the garden.
exampleTranslation: Bọn trẻ chơi trốn tìm trong vườn.

word: take the kids to the park
definition: to go to the park with children
translation: đưa các con ra công viên
exampleSentence: I take the kids to the park on Sundays.
exampleTranslation: Chủ nhật tôi đưa các con ra công viên.

definition: to speak angrily to someone because they did something wrong
exampleSentence: She told her son off for lying.
exampleTranslation: Cô ấy mắng con trai vì nói dối.

definition: to take care of children
exampleSentence: My mother looks after the children.
exampleTranslation: Mẹ tôi trông các cháu.

definition: to give a child medicine to take
exampleSentence: I give my son medicine twice a day.
exampleTranslation: Tôi cho con trai uống thuốc hai lần mỗi ngày.

definition: to put clothes on a baby
translation: mặc quần áo cho em bé
exampleSentence: I dress the baby in warm clothes.
exampleTranslation: Tôi mặc quần áo ấm cho em bé.

definition: to find out how to ride a bicycle
exampleSentence: My daughter is learning to ride a bike.
exampleTranslation: Con gái tôi đang tập đi xe đạp.
